description:
Returns details of an issue security level.

Use [Get issue security scheme](#api-rest-api-3-issuesecurityschemes-id-get) to obtain the IDs of issue security levels associated with the issue security scheme.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** None.

parameters.description: The ID of the issue security level.
parameters.name: id

application/json.example: {"description":"Only the reporter and internal staff can see this issue.","id":"10021","name":"Reporter Only","self":"https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/securitylevel/10021"}

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.

404.description: Returned if the issue security level is not found.
